reason: The cited evidence notes that Cr coatings peel/crack in high-temperature steam (E2) and that Al or Si is necessary for ATF cladding design (E2), but provides no specific prior evidence that Al addition forms a stable, self-healing alumina barrier at the Cr/Zr interface, that such a barrier retards Cr-Zr interdiffusion, or that the modified coating maintains Cr2O3 protection under normal conditions. These key mechanistic premises are unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Al addition to Cr coating can form a protective Al2O3 barrier
Al2O3 barrier reduces Cr-Zr interdiffusion by retarding atomic mobility
